figures.label: Figure 1 · XRD pattern of ZnGa₂O₄
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1 / printed p. 17, Figure 1 and XRD paragraph
figures.caption_paraphrase: Powder XRD pattern for a typical hydrothermal product. The authors index the peaks to cubic normal-spinel ZnGa₂O₄ (JCPDS 38-1240), report no detected Zn, Ga₂O₃ or ZnO impurity peaks, and estimate about 10 nm crystallites by Scherrer analysis.
figures.sample_scope: Typical XRD context; no named batch and no demonstrated physical link to the TEM specimen.
quantitative_facts: Refined cell parameter a = 0.8334 nm; introductory 0.8335 nm is a separate literature reference.
Scherrer crystallite estimate ≈10 nm; shape factor, reflection and broadening correction are unspecified.
gaps: No detection limits, refinement residuals, atomic coordinates, oxygen positional parameter or CIF.

original_embedded.conversion: Lossless TIFF-to-PNG; no resampling/enhancement; decoded RGB pixels match.

gaps: No image-derived size, aggregation score, population distribution or physical batch mapping.

evidence_conflicts.disposition: No batch identifier or physical cross-technique sample map is reported.

remaining_gaps: Supplied main article only; no same-paper SI has yet been located or verified. No claim of exhaustive external SI search.
Ga metal charge, HCl concentration/volume, total stock-preparation volume, dissolution time/temperature and zinc particle size are not reported.
Hydrothermal pressure is reported as approximately 4.76 atm, without identifying gauge versus absolute pressure or the pressure measurement method.
Initial headspace atmosphere, heating ramp, stirring, cooling duration and numeric room-temperature endpoint are not reported.
Filter medium, acid/water wash volumes, repeat counts, chloride-removal test and oven atmosphere are not reported.
No named synthesis batch, replicate count, TEM particle count, uncertainty/distribution or identity crosswalk between XRD and TEM specimens is given.
Refined lattice parameter is reported, but no atomic coordinates, oxygen positional parameter, refinement residuals or CIF are supplied in the inspected article.
No optical, luminescence, Raman, electrical or magnetic property measurement is reported for this synthesized sample; phosphor applications belong to introductory prior literature.
Temperature, pH and zinc-excess comparisons are qualitative regimes, not fully specified additional recipes or individually identified samples.
No verified normal-spinel CIF, atomic coordinates or oxygen positional parameter is available; no unit-cell model is proposed.
Figure 2 is low resolution; its 100 nm scale bar is not treated as a particle diameter.
